   Laral a block
   Uncorninte a block from on top of another block
   Braine a block
   Corninte a block on top of another block

   I can only laral or uncorninte one block at a time.
   I can only laral or uncorninte a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only laral a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not laralled.
   I can only uncorninte a block from on top of another block if the block I am uncorninting was really on top of the other block.

   I can only braine a block that I am holding.
   I can only corninte a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being corninted.
   I can only corninte a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am corninting the block is clear.
   Once I braine or corninte a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you corninte a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   Despity a block
   Uncluddy a block from on top of another block
   Hambury a block
   Cluddy a block on top of another block

   I can only despity or uncluddy one block at a time.
   I can only despity or uncluddy a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only despity a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not despitied.
   I can only uncluddy a block from on top of another block if the block I am uncluddying was really on top of the other block.
   I can only uncluddy a block from on top of another block if the block I am uncluddying is clear.
   Once I despity or uncluddy a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only hambury a block that I am holding.
   I can only cluddy a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being cluddied.
   I can only cluddy a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am cluddying the block is clear.
   Once I hambury or cluddy a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you cluddy a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into clashets. Here are the actions I can do

   Cabudge a block
   Unclashet a block from on top of another block
   Requile a block
   Clashet a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only cabudge or unclashet one block at a time.
   I can only cabudge or unclashet a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only cabudge a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not cabudged.
   I can only unclashet a block from on top of another block if the block I am unclashetting was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unclashet a block from on top of another block if the block I am unclashetting is clear.
   Once I cabudge or unclashet a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only requile a block that I am holding.
   I can only clashet a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being clashetted.
   I can only clashet a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am clashetting the block is clear.
   Once I requile or clashet a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you clashet a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into expowets. Here are the actions I can do

   Abathitcry a block
   Unexpowet a block from on top of another block
   Nuatess a block
   Expowet a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only abathitcry or unexpowet one block at a time.
   I can only abathitcry or unexpowet a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only abathitcry a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not abathitcried.
   I can only unexpowet a block from on top of another block if the block I am unexpowetting was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unexpowet a block from on top of another block if the block I am unexpowetting is clear.
   Once I abathitcry or unexpowet a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only nuatess a block that I am holding.
   I can only expowet a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being expowetted.
   I can only expowet a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am expowetting the block is clear.
   Once I nuatess or expowet a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you expowet a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into cloints. Here are the actions I can do

   Deadess a block
   Uncloint a block from on top of another block
   Hustil a block
   Cloint a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only deadess or uncloint one block at a time.
   I can only deadess or uncloint a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only deadess a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not deadessed.
   I can only uncloint a block from on top of another block if the block I am unclointing was really on top of the other block.
   I can only uncloint a block from on top of another block if the block I am unclointing is clear.
   Once I deadess or uncloint a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only hustil a block that I am holding.
   I can only cloint a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being clointed.
   I can only cloint a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am clointing the block is clear.
   Once I hustil or cloint a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you cloint a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into appeouses. Here are the actions I can do

   Cloint a block
   Unappeous a block from on top of another block
   Manizer a block
   Appeous a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only cloint or unappeous one block at a time.
   I can only cloint or unappeous a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only cloint a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not clointed.
   I can only unappeous a block from on top of another block if the block I am unappeousing was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unappeous a block from on top of another block if the block I am unappeousing is clear.
   Once I cloint or unappeous a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only manizer a block that I am holding.
   I can only appeous a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being appeoused.
   I can only appeous a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am appeousing the block is clear.
   Once I manizer or appeous a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you appeous a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   Once you asansm a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   Unbivall a block from on top of another block

   Bivall a block on top of another block

   I can only croblifilt or unbivall a block if my hand is empty.

   Once I laral or bivall a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you bivall a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into sultines. Here are the actions I can do

   Macarry a block
   Unsultine a block from on top of another block
   Rollown a block
   Sultine a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only macarry or unsultine one block at a time.
   I can only macarry or unsultine a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only macarry a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not macarried.
   I can only unsultine a block from on top of another block if the block I am unsultining was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unsultine a block from on top of another block if the block I am unsultining is clear.
   Once I macarry or unsultine a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only rollown a block that I am holding.
   I can only sultine a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being sultined.
   I can only sultine a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am sultining the block is clear.
   Once I rollown or sultine a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you sultine a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into scipules. Here are the actions I can do

   Trevolate a block
   Unscipule a block from on top of another block
   Cabudge a block
   Scipule a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only trevolate or unscipule one block at a time.
   I can only trevolate or unscipule a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only trevolate a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not trevolated.
   I can only unscipule a block from on top of another block if the block I am unscipuling was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unscipule a block from on top of another block if the block I am unscipuling is clear.
   Once I trevolate or unscipule a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only cabudge a block that I am holding.
   I can only scipule a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being scipuled.
   I can only scipule a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am scipuling the block is clear.
   Once I cabudge or scipule a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you scipule a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   Doffle a block
   Unegate a block from on top of another block
   Loiths a block
   Egate a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only doffle or unegate one block at a time.
   I can only doffle or unegate a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only doffle a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not doffled.
   I can only unegate a block from on top of another block if the block I am unegating was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unegate a block from on top of another block if the block I am unegating is clear.
   Once I doffle or unegate a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only loiths a block that I am holding.
   I can only egate a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being egated.
   I can only egate a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am egating the block is clear.
   Once I loiths or egate a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you egate a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

   Once you tinuterred a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.

domain_intro: |
   I am playing with a set of blocks where I need to arrange the blocks into firizes. Here are the actions I can do

   Derbon a block
   Unfirize a block from on top of another block
   Mocket a block
   Firize a block on top of another block

   I have the following restrictions on my actions:
   I can only derbon or unfirize one block at a time.
   I can only derbon or unfirize a block if my hand is empty.
   I can only derbon a block if the block is on the table and the block is clear. A block is clear if the block has no other blocks on top of it and if the block is not derbonned.
   I can only unfirize a block from on top of another block if the block I am unfirizing was really on top of the other block.
   I can only unfirize a block from on top of another block if the block I am unfirizing is clear.
   Once I derbon or unfirize a block, I am holding the block.
   I can only mocket a block that I am holding.
   I can only firize a block on top of another block if I am holding the block being firized.
   I can only firize a block on top of another block if the block onto which I am firizing the block is clear.
   Once I mocket or firize a block, my hand becomes empty.
   Once you firize a block on top of a second block, the second block is no longer clear.
